questions.question_text: Swamini Vatoma (4/119) Mahārāje kai vātne nitye vichārvā jevī kahī chhe?
options: Keṭlākne man ramāḍe chhe ne keṭlāk manne ramāḍe chhe.
Sant kahe tem karavu te shreṣhṭh chhe.
Manmukhi na thavu pan agnama rahevu.
questions.correct_answer: Keṭlākne man ramāḍe chhe ne keṭlāk manne ramāḍe chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Swamini Vato 4/119: 'Keṭlākne man ramāḍe chhe ne keṭlāk manne ramāḍe chhe. Ā vāt nitye vichārvā jevī chhe.'

questions.question_text: Swamini Vatoma (2/57) 'shreṣhṭh' ane 'kaniṣhṭh' koṇne kahyā chhe?
options: Sant kahe tem karavu te shreṣhṭh chhe ne mandhāryu karavu te kaniṣhṭh chhe.
Mandhāryu karavu te shreṣhṭh chhe ne sant kahe tem karavu te kaniṣhṭh chhe.
Mangamtu karavu te shreṣhṭh chhe ne sant kahe tem karavu te kaniṣhṭh chhe.
Āḷasu hoy ne ūnghato hoy te shreṣhṭh chhe ne sant kahe tem kare te kaniṣhṭh chhe.
questions.correct_answer: Sant kahe tem karavu te shreṣhṭh chhe ne mandhāryu karavu te kaniṣhṭh chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Swamini Vato 2/57: 'Sant kahe tem karavu te shreṣhṭh chhe ne mandhāryu karavu te kaniṣhṭh chhe.'

questions.question_text: Purushottam Bolya Prite pramāṇe, Ingoralama Shri Harie kahyu ke amara janoe ________ na thavu pan ________ rahevu.
questions.explanation: As per Purushottam Bolya Prite: 'Ingoralama Shri Harie kahyu: Amara janoe manmukhi na thavu pan agnama rahevu.'

questions.question_text: Vachanamrut Vartal 1 pramāṇe, je kalyāṇne ichchhe tene to ________ sāthe jarūr vair bāndhvu.
questions.explanation: As per Vachanamrut Vartal 1: 'Je kalyāṇne ichchhe tene to man sāthe jarūr vair bāndhvu.'

questions.question_text: Vachanvidhi (4/5) pramāṇe, "So vātnī ek vāt chhe, nav karvo ________; Rājī karvānu rahyu paru, paṇ karāviye nahi Harine kop."
questions.explanation: As per Vachanvidhi 4/5: 'So vātnī ek vāt chhe, nav karvo āgnālop; Rājī karvānu rahyu paru, paṇ karāviye nahi Harine kop.'

questions.question_text: Sar-Siddhi (28/9) pramāṇe, "Pragaṭ Prabhunā vachan pāḷe, ethī moṭo koī ________ chhe."
questions.explanation: As per Sar-Siddhi 28/9: 'Dharma dharma sahu koī kahe, paṇ dharmamā bahu marm chhe; Pragaṭ Prabhunā vachan pāḷe, ethī moṭo koī dharma chhe.'

questions.question_text: Swamini Vatoma (6/156) Mahārāje shu kahyu hatu ke "koī niyam bhang karsho mā, ne jene karvo hoy te ________ rahesho mā, ne ā je sūraj sarkhī godaḍiyu temā bhalā thaīne ________ desho mā."
questions.explanation: As per Swamini Vato 6/156: 'Ek vār Mahārāje ūbhā thaīne kahyu hatu je, koī niyam bhang karsho mā, ne jene karvo hoy te satsangmā rahesho mā, ne ā je sūraj sarkhī godaḍiyu temā bhalā thaīne ḍāgh lāgvā desho mā.'

questions.question_text: Vachanvidhi (42/2) pramāṇe, "________ niyamne kām na karvu, Mar hoy lābh jo lākhno; Toy lalchāviye nahi lesh manne, Jāṇiye mavāḷo kākhno."
questions.explanation: As per Vachanvidhi 42/2: 'Ṭhelī niyamne kām na karvu, Mar hoy lābh jo lākhno; Toy lalchāviye nahi lesh manne, Jāṇiye mavāḷo kākhno.'

questions.question_text: Bhaktichintamani (76/39-41) pramāṇe, sukh duhkha āve sarve bheḷu, temā shu rākhjyo?
questions.explanation: As per Bhaktichintamani 76/39-41: 'Sukh duhkha āve sarve bheḷu, temā rākhjyo sthir mati;'

questions.question_text: Bhaktichintamani (76/39-41) pramāṇe, "Paṇ vrat ṭek jo ṭāḷsho to, ________ sahu sahu taṇu."
questions.explanation: As per Bhaktichintamani 76/39-41: 'Em kartā jo panḍ paḍshe, to āgaḷ sukh chhe ati ghaṇu; Paṇ vrat ṭek jo ṭāḷsho to, bhogavsho sahu sahu taṇu.'
